name: Unending Tears

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You force sorrow upon your target, and their eyes well with water, impairing their vision and making them weep uncontrollably. The target must attempt a Will save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Dazzled until they Interact to clear their vision.

Failure The target is dazzled and Stupefied 1, and one ongoing emotion effect on them of your choice that has a lower counteract rank than this spell is suppressed for the spell's duration.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target can't speak for as long as they are stupefied.
